title: Its ok.
text:
Its ok.. This review is for:
Mr. Coffee BVMC-HTKSS200 Stainless Steel Hot Tea Kettle, Stainless Steel (Kitchen)

Looks very nice, but I think it's a pain in the neck going through all it takes to make Tea in this,And I'm a tea drinker.
I have a wonderful tea maker, but the water runs through plastic.
Thanx to "M." below, gave info that this is Glass..

This holds 5 cups of water.
To be fair, I did not use loose tea. I used 5 tea bags of Organic Chamomile Tea, as it suggest I could do.
I pressed the bags down with A spoon in the Infuser. After it finished brewing, I pushed on the tea bags with a spoon to get all the tea out.
My tea still came out weak!!

First, fill the kettle up to 5, or lower, press the On button. Once it's beeps, now its time to put the infuser in, but taking the middle cap off, putting the tea infuser with your tea inside it, Inside the kettle through the middle opening. Push the button to what type of tea your using. Not sure what button to press if your not sure of the
Temp. of what your tea should be seeping at, Since it was not marked on the base!!
Once infuser is put down in kettle, which I at first found difficult. Make sure that it all fits near the handle, not where you pour it at..Make sure your middle cap is seated down right, and the top lid closes down tight.
After the tea has stopped brewing, take out the tea infuser.
Push the button to keep your tea warm for a hour.
That said , I do not expect to drink 5 cups of tea in a hour.

I feel I have to baby sit this tea maker for each stage waiting for the beeps, then go to the next step, wait for the beeps to push button's to make tea in this.
